reviewer.context_id: C-independent-spec-auditor; exact delegated session ID bound by parent registration amendment

review_basis: C independently read all final query text and criteria during pre-freeze correction review, reread the 45 semantic/functional query rows after actual-text packet preparation, and had previously read exact/diagnostic rows in full. These are controlled data-evidence needs, not guarantees of production utility or product certification. Subsequent scope amendment changed neither queries nor intent/rule bytes. Actual per-document evidence remains subject to fresh reviewers.

intent_rationales.s01: The observed/measured/empirical variants all name cacao/cocoa/Theobroma and field crop pest suppression or treatment trials. Insect/arthropod readings are supported by the actual inspected insect-count metadata, not an invented geography. Counts, treatment category and application-rate observations are complementary completeness criteria, not mandatory hidden product attributes.
intent_rationales.s02: All variants explicitly name cacao/cocoa crop productivity/harvest yield and CSV/comma-separated output. Harvest mass and area establish yield; season adds temporal completeness. The revised orchard variant now actually says cacao. PDF-only is a stated-format mismatch, not a category shortcut.
intent_rationales.s03: All variants ask for observed/measured/empirical postharvest cacao-bean fermentation, including time/temperature or curing before drying. They do not denote cultured dairy beverage fermentation. Batch mass is an independently documented experiment variable, not inferred from the word batch.
intent_rationales.s04: Cocoa/cacao/Theobroma nursery seedlings and empirical propagation/establishment are expressed in every variant. Survival, propagation method and rooting duration document the stated trial; factory sanitation is a different meaning of plant and not requested here.
intent_rationales.s05: Every variant specifies empirical/measured protective packaging of solid milk/dairy-enriched chocolate bars or slabs. Wrapper material, barrier performance and seal failure measure packaging performance. A chocolate-milk drink container is not the requested product, and simulation-only is now excluded by the visible query wording.
intent_rationales.s06: Solid chocolate is now explicit in the texture/fracture/brittleness variants, preventing the earlier confectionery-only hidden restriction. Mechanical fracture and tempering are directly related to snap/texture; particle-size measurements add complementary completeness without being inferred from product identity.
intent_rationales.s07: The empirical variants concern stored edible chocolate/cacao ingredients before baking or dessert preparation, not finished dairy drinks or unrelated logistics. Temperature, ingredient quality and moisture are appropriate measured storage evidence; the queries do not impose a publisher, region or hidden required format.
intent_rationales.s08: Chocolate/confectionery processing equipment or cacao-sweets works identifies factory sanitation, not growing plants. Observed swabs, cleaning validation and hygiene verification are equivalent controlled evidence needs; residue mass is an additional independent sanitation measurement.
intent_rationales.s09: All variants explicitly describe empirically preparing a cocoa/chocolate drink from powder with water, including hot-cup dissolution. Powder dose, water temperature and dissolution time answer the intended preparation tests. Baking-only dessert reconstitution is a distinct process.
intent_rationales.s10: All revised variants express empirical refrigerated chocolate/cacao dairy-drink shelf life and CSV/comma-separated files. Oat drinks are no longer a defensible alternate product reading because dairy is visible. Storage temperature, spoilage interval and microbial counts are independent shelf-life observations.
intent_rationales.s11: All revised variants explicitly say chocolate/cacao dairy drink/refreshment and empirical formulation/recipe proportions. Cocoa and sweetener fractions and liquid viscosity document formulation, unlike oat-only drinks, solid dessert ingredients or container design. No hidden region or required format is introduced.
intent_rationales.s12: The empirical variants consistently concern chocolate/cacao dairy-beverage fermentation or microbial souring, not postharvest beans, oat-only drinks or pasteurization. Culture identification, acidification and residual sugar support progressively complete fermentation evidence. A souring query is not interpreted as a demand for an unmentioned proprietary starter or certification.
intent_rationales.f01: Observed/empirical running footwear traction on wet pavement, rain-soaked asphalt and wet sealed paths denotes one controlled test need. Friction, surface roughness and water-film depth are independent measurements; observed tests inform suitability rather than implying an unstated certification threshold. A sole-only inventory is not a complete running-shoe test.
intent_rationales.f02: All variants specify empirical/observed or measured low-noise hydraulic circulation indoors. Noise level, microphone distance and flow document acoustic performance under operation; unloaded inventories and interface standards do not. Quiet is interpreted as the explicitly stated indoor low-noise test domain, not an invented universal compliance standard.
intent_rationales.f03: All final variants explicitly request measured/observed temperature-probe coldroom calibration from minus twenty to plus five Celsius. Error, test range and reference-instrument uncertainty are independent observations. The unsupported word traceable was removed; no traceability chain or unmentioned certification is required.
intent_rationales.d01: Drink is deliberately broad: ready liquid beverages and powders intended for drink preparation can both be useful. The frozen diagnostic map is exploratory and is not a requirement for a whole family to rank first.
intent_rationales.d02: Dessert is a broad exploratory category covering ingredient storage, solid confectionery and other defensible nearby preparation meanings. Its graded diagnostic map is not used for promotion or single-domain precision.
intent_rationales.d03: Plant retains crop/nursery and manufacturing-factory interpretations. The explicit multi-process diagnostic map acknowledges both instead of inheriting a single product restriction.
intent_rationales.d04: Storage remains an exploratory multi-process request including ingredient, refrigerated beverage and relevant packaging/storage processes, without adding a requested CSV or empirical-only requirement.
intent_rationales.n01: The no-answer need is the conjunction of lunar cacao cultivation and cadmium isotope ratios, not either token alone. Corpus-wide conjunction absence is still an actual-text audit responsibility; no ordinary NDCG zero or empty-result ranking win follows.
intent_rationales.n02: The no-answer need is the absent RUN-X9999 identity together with cryogenic-vacuum running-shoe certification. Nearby shoe identities or generic certification words are not an answer; absence remains a full actual-text audit responsibility.

exact_control_rationale: This is an intentionally declared controlled navigation lookup, not an open-ended semantic request. Its exact string, declared alias or frozen exact title identifies the authoritative dataset; component, model, prefix, version, I/1 and O/0 contrasts are not equivalent. Case and hyphenation equivalences are restricted to the explicitly registered single SKU. Title/distribution placement controls constrain primary metadata as amended without changing identity or production-derived embedding text. No unconfigured keyword equality operator is presumed.
